name: n4_navigate
description: List the children of a component (name, type, handle, has_children). depth > 1 nests grandchildren under a 'children' key. elapsed_ms is the load time. For a station inventory use n4_bql_query or n4_inventory instead: one navigate is one round trip per component. types (optional) keeps only children whose type is one of the given specs (e.g. bacnet:BacnetDevice) plus the path to them; each kept entry then carries matched true/false. has_children ignores the types filter: it is true when the entry has any component child, matching or not. types keeps a given type and its subtypes; types_note says when the registry could not be read. Each component or struct slot whose children are listed also lists the declared properties the station left out at their default (handle null), marked default: true with their value, or value null and a note when the type contract gives no default value; the sub-entries of a declared struct default are marked default too and may show type null. defaults_note says when a type contract could not be read, and names a declared default that could not be decoded (left out).

types.description: Optional type specs to keep, e.g. ['bacnet:BacnetDevice']; default: no filter
